scope: Read-only proposed capture optimization; active rig unchanged

findings.issue: Default render_subframes=3 forces three render generations
findings.reason: SimulationContext.render increments render_generation; each following ensure_isaac_rtx_render_update receives a new dedup key and can pump Kit
findings.smallest_experiment: Use existing --render-subframes 1; preserve physics/IMU cadence and validate moving RGB/ToF/overhead alignment

findings.issue: Sequential RGB, ToF and overhead Camera.update do not normally each pump Kit
findings.reason: Same simulation id, physics_step and render_generation match the renderer update key; later camera requests reuse the rendered products
findings.next_optimization: Camera.update_batch on all three cameras may avoid repeated scene-state update work, but needs actual GPU benchmark

findings.reason: External timestamp_s records actual physics time correctly; Camera internal clock only advances one physics tick per capture
findings.proposal: Use actual timestamp_s minus previous_capture_s, alternating .065/.070 at 200Hz physics; same elapsed for all three cameras

findings.reason: Repeated GPU-to-CPU tensor reads at 200Hz and synchronous RGB+overhead+paired PNG writes at15Hz can be expensive
findings.proposal: Instrument physics/IMU/capture/encode/disk timing first; batch readback and bounded asynchronous IO without dropping any physics evidence

must_preserve: 15Hz RGB/ToF/overhead at one identical acquisition physics tick
Separate ToF optical origin and 8x8 angular projection
No invented or interpolated sensor frames
not_claimed: GPU validation of single-subframe dynamic imagery
